name: Frosted Glass
description: A frosted panel over a real blur. The scene behind the surface is blurred and tinted by a slowly turning two-colour gradient. A crystalline grain and a soft vignette sit on top. Where nothing sits behind the surface it falls back to the original translucent gradient slab. The Content opacity parameter sets how much of the window content stays visible over the pane.
author: PlasmaZones

parameters.name: Blur radius
parameters.description: How strongly the scene behind the surface is blurred (px). Past a display scale of 125% the top of the range stops adding blur, and the lowest setting is already a soft blur rather than none

parameters.name: Corner radius
parameters.description: Corner rounding of the pane (px, match the Border pack)

parameters.name: Content opacity
parameters.description: How visible the window content stays over the frosted pane, where 1.0 is fully opaque and 0.0 shows only the blurred backdrop

parameters.name: Grain amount
parameters.description: Strength of the crystalline frost grain

parameters.name: Grain scale
parameters.description: Density of the frost crystals. A wider window gets proportionally more of them rather than wider ones

parameters.name: Grain drift
parameters.description: How quickly the fine frost detail drifts, where 0 freezes it

parameters.name: Gradient strength
parameters.description: How much of the gradient colour is mixed over the blurred scene

parameters.name: Gradient speed
parameters.description: How quickly the gradient turns and drifts, where 0 freezes it

parameters.name: Gradient angle
parameters.description: Starting direction of the gradient in degrees, measured across the pane rather than on screen, so 45 runs corner to corner whatever shape the window is. It holds as a fixed direction only when Gradient speed is 0, since any other speed keeps turning it

parameters.name: Round bottom corners
parameters.description: Round the bottom corners as well as the top. Turn off to round only the top two, for a pane that sits against a panel or the screen edge. The whole chain follows one answer, taken from the first pack that carries the setting, so the bottom corners are all rounded or all square.

parameters.name: Edge softness
parameters.description: Anti-alias feather of the pane edge, in device pixels, so it does not grow with display scaling. Lower is crisper.

parameters.name: Vignette
parameters.description: How much the pane darkens toward its top and bottom edges

parameters.name: Brightness
parameters.description: Gain on the blurred scene. 1.0 leaves it as captured

parameters.name: Contrast
parameters.description: Contrast of the blurred scene around mid grey. 1.0 leaves it as captured

parameters.name: Saturation
parameters.description: Colour saturation of the blurred scene. 0 is greyscale and 1.0 leaves it as captured

parameters.name: Vibrancy
parameters.description: Boosts saturation where a colour is already saturated and bright, so muted scenes stay muted. 0 turns it off, and Vibrancy darkness widens it to darker colours

parameters.name: Vibrancy darkness
parameters.description: How far the vibrancy boost reaches into darker colours. Does nothing while Vibrancy is 0, which is where it starts
